'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a NPC male Gladiator and the leader of '''Beasts Beneath'''. He can be found talking with '''Domilius Ouro''' about sponsorships in {{Location|Capitoline Hill}}. 

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(After completing {{Quest|Flames of Heart}})
:'''Domilius Ouro''': Nero, have you decided?
:'''Domilius Ouro''': Join us! We can provide extra funding for the Beasts Beneath. You'll also get better gear, have better medical conditions, and more tournament opportunities!
:'''Domilius Ouro''': Look, you just need to accept these promotion deals, and I'll arrange more exhibition matches for you. Just think about the opportunities!
:'''Nero:''' ...
:'''Domilius Ouro''': Nero, I know you want to keep your team going. I'll give you some time to think about it.
:'''Nero:''' ...Okay.
----
;(Next Day)
:'''Domilius Ouro''': Nero. Well?
:'''Nero:''' I've made my decision, Mr. Ouro. I'm sorry, but the Beasts Beneath wishes to decline your sponsorship.
:'''Nero:''' We were deeply moved by Miss Lupa's spirit during the finals, so we decided to stick to our goals by continuing our fight on our own.
:'''Domilius Ouro''': Hahaha, that's great! I admire your words of courage. Even in Septimont!
:'''Domilius Ouro''': In that case, Nero. Have a look at this, then.
:'''Nero:''' What is this...?
:'''Domilius Ouro''': This investment plan is more aligned with the spirit of "pure competition", and I'm sure it'll pique your interest.
{{Dialogue End}}
